# nagios_host (Data Source)

Reads an existing Nagios XI host.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nagios_host" "example" {
  host_name = "web01.example.com"
}

output "web01_address" {
  value = data.nagios_host.example.address
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `host_name` (String) The name of the host
